Container.Name: Splat
Container.Overview:
Splat: design 3D-printable parts by chatting with Claude. Claude Code runs inside the container and writes OpenSCAD; you get a live 3D preview, customizer sliders, version history for every change, imports (STL, 3MF, OBJ, STEP, SVG, DXF) and exports (3MF, STL, STEP, OBJ, glTF, SVG, DXF and more), plus an OrcaSlicer handoff.
Connect Claude with either a Claude subscription token (run "claude setup-token" on any computer) or an Anthropic API key, here or later in the app's Settings. A Hermes Agent gateway can be used instead of Claude Code.

Config.Name: App data
Config.Description: Projects (each a git repository with full version history), settings and Claude Code's own state.

Config.Name: App password
Config.Description: Optional login password for the web UI. Strongly recommended if the app is reachable from the internet (Claude can run commands inside this container).

Config.Name: Claude subscription token
Config.Description: Optional. Output of 'claude setup-token' (uses your Claude Pro/Max plan). Can also be set in the app's Settings.

Config.Name: Anthropic API key
Config.Description: Optional. Pay-as-you-go API key from console.anthropic.com. Can also be set in the app's Settings.

Config.Name: Claude model
Config.Description: Optional default model (opus, sonnet, haiku or a full model id). Settings in the app override this.

Config.Name: Chat assistant
Config.Description: claude = Claude Code inside this container (default). hermes = a Hermes Agent gateway (set its URL and key below). Can also be changed in the app's Settings.

Config.Name: Hermes URL
Config.Description: Optional. Hermes Agent API server, e.g. http://hermes:8642 (API_SERVER_ENABLED=true on the Hermes side).

Config.Name: Render timeout (seconds)
Config.Description: Longest a single OpenSCAD render may run.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User id that owns files in appdata (Unraid default: 99 = nobody).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group id that owns files in appdata (Unraid default: 100 = users).
